articles.title: Mexican killers of U.S., Australian surfers sentenced to 158 years in prison - CBS News
articles.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and Carter Rhoad were on a surfing trip to Mexico's Baja California when they were killed during an attempted robbery.
articles.content:
A Mexican judge on Friday sentenced three men to more than 158 years of imprisonment for the murder of two Australian surfers and their American friend during an attempted robbery in 2024.
